name: T1 Energy Inc.
old_description: T1 Energy (formerly FREYR Battery) is an Austin, Texas-headquartered manufacturer building domestic solar module and battery supply chains, with plants in Dallas and Austin.
about:
T1 Energy Inc., headquartered in Austin, Texas, operates as a manufacturer of solar photovoltaic modules and lithium‑ion battery cells. The company, formerly known as FREYR Battery, is building domestic solar and battery supply chains with production facilities in Dallas (G1) and Austin (G2). No founding year or ownership details are disclosed in the available sources.

The company produces solar modules using TOPCon N‑type cell technology, incorporating silicon nitride coating, atomic‑layer alumina front‑passivation, boron‑doped polysilicon regions, and screen‑printed silver/aluminum busbars. Battery cell manufacturing is in a planned expansion phase. Projected capacity for Q1 2026 includes 935 MW of module production and $250.1 million in net sales. Facility size and headcount are not publicly specified.

T1 Energy serves utility, residential, commercial, and grid‑storage markets. Concrete customer engagements include a strategic offtake agreement with Clearway and the acquisition of advanced solar intellectual property from Evervolt. The company also references a data‑center development project (Giga Arctic) indicating expansion into the data‑center energy segment.

The stated mission is to invigorate America with scalable, reliable, low‑cost energy by establishing domestic manufacturing capacity. The company emphasizes next‑generation industrial‑scale PV technology designed for maximum efficiency and longevity, leveraging abundant materials such as silicon, glass, and aluminum.
